beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)[0]

Z = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(all_exp)), z])

print("gamma var:", gamma)
print("resid mean/std:", resid.mean(), resid.std(ddof=1))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def model(regime, n, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    T = float(regime.config.get("T", 1.0))
    # Mean fitted from fresh experiment lots
    b0, b1, b2 = {beta[0]!r}, {beta[1]!r}, {beta[2]!r}
    mu = b0 + b1*T + b2*(T**2)

    # Mild heteroskedasticity fit; keep positive and conservative
    g0, g1 = {gamma[0]!r}, {gamma[1]!r}
    var = g0 + g1*abs(T - 1.0)
    sd = float(np.sqrt(max(var, 1.2)))

    # Heavy-tailed lot-to-lot variation
    y = mu + sd * rng.standard_t(df=6, size=n) / np.sqrt(6/4)
    y = np.clip(y, 0, 100)

    return pd.DataFrame({{"unit_id": np.arange(n), "y": y}})
'''
